title: Named Relation Corroboration v1
description: Independent evidence that may corroborate entity identity or group linkage without upgrading transaction amount, direction, continuity, or economic significance.

const: corroboration availability is not earlier than source availability or visual review
identity or control corroboration does not confirm transaction amount or direction
ownership or group status is not a production-flow edge
corroboration does not extend the relation beyond its original report period
